description:
Bypass. hooks/lib/protected.py:345-353 protects agent definitions by file stem only. Claude Code takes agent_type from frontmatter name, so .claude/agents/helper.md with `name: adw-test-writer` (also .claude/agents/sub/adw-test-writer.md, .codex/agents/helper.toml with name = "adw-test-writer", .omp/agents/helper.md) passes and opens the test gate in the next session.

Fix: block any write under an agents directory (project or user scope, Claude/Codex/OMP) whose content declares the name adw-test-writer, in markdown frontmatter or TOML, keep the stem check.

Acceptance: those four writes return test_writer_definition; an unrelated agent file still passes. Tests by adw-test-writer.
title: Block agent files that declare the adw-test-writer name under any file name
